newsitem.title: JAPAN: Teleway says Toyota may provide financial support.
newsitem.headline: Teleway says Toyota may provide financial support.

text.p: Teleway Japan Corp, a debt-ridden telecommunications affiliate of Toyota Motor Corp, said on Tuesday that it was discussing financial-support measures with Toyota.
"One possibility is a third-party allocation of new shares to Toyota, but nothing has been decided yet," a Teleway spokeswoman said.
She said Teleway Japan's debts exceeded assets by 14.8 billion yen at the end of March 1997.
Toyota, the biggest shareholder, now holds a 38.3 percent stake in Teleway Japan after boosting that several times in the past.
Teleway announced earlier on Tuesday that it would offer seamless phone service combining international and domestic services jointly with Kokusai Denshin Denwa Co.
